talents.name: Chain Reaction
talents.desc:
**Normal Attack**
Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal **Electro DMG**.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal **AoE Electro DMG** to the area in front after a short casting time.
Mitya will instead perform the special Charged Attack **Gradient Detonation**, which consumes no Stamina, if a **Detection Core: Overload** created by Mitya himself is currently on the field and he has at least 1 **Gradient Beacon**: Deals 1 instance of **AoE Electro DMG** to the area in front and continuously consumes **Gradient Beacons** while held. Each **Gradient Beacon** consumed deals 1 instance of **AoE Electro DMG** to the area in front that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing **AoE Electro DMG** upon impact.
[Details title="Detection Core"]An energy device Mitya creates after using his Elemental Skill. Tapping it creates a Core in **Steady State**, while holding it creates an **Overloaded** core.

**Detection Core: Steady State**
·Continuously follows nearby opponents and intermittently deals **AoE Electro DMG**;
·When Mitya has reached the maximum number of **Gradient Beacons** he can have, the device will consume any newly generated **Gradient Beacon** and deal **AoE Electro DMG** that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG;
·When its duration ends or another **Detection Core** is created, the device will consume all **Gradient Beacons** Mitya has and deal **AoE Electro DMG** that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG based on the number consumed.

**Detection Core: Overloaded**
·While this device is present and Mitya has at least 1 **Gradient Beacon**, he can perform the special Charged Attack **Gradient Detonation** without consuming Stamina.[/Details]
[Details title="Gradient Beacons"]When Mitya is in the party and a Stellar-Conduct reaction is triggered, a **Gradient Beacon** that lasts for 6s will be created instead of a **Starlight Prism**. Mitya can consume **Gradient Beacons** to trigger various effects.
**Gradient Beacons** follow the active character and transform a larger nearby area into a **Polestar Field** when a **Gradient Beacon** is created. Mitya can have multiple **Gradient Beacons**, with an initial maximum of 4. Creating a **Gradient Beacon** will reset the duration of all **Gradient Beacons**.[/Details]
